headline: I partner with you on the games that truly matter to you.
paragraphs: Most coaching is sold as time: a number of sessions, a rhythm, an hour here and there. I work the other way around. We start with the game you are actually playing, the one that matters enough to change how your year goes. Then we agree on what winning it looks like, specific enough that we will both know when it has happened.

The outcomes are yours. Clients have used this work for anything from doubling revenue to changing behavior to creating more peace and joy in their day. Growth in numbers and growth in the person tend to arrive together; it is rarely one without the other.
I am not a spectator in this. I think with you, I push where you would rather not look, and I hold on to what you said you wanted when you are tempted to quietly make it smaller.
We measure transparently. Not by how the sessions felt, but by what changed: in your results, in your leadership, and in what the people around you notice. If it changed, we see it.
